HOW IT WORKS

A clear workflow from start to finish

Export tools are available across supported areas. Broad CSV or Excel importing with pre-processing validation was not verified and is identified as planned.

01

Choose the record type

Start with invoices, customers, items, expenses, reports, or another supported area.

02

Set filters

Limit the export to the records and date range you actually need.

03

Generate the file

Use the available Excel, PDF, or print action for that area.

04

Validate before import

The planned import flow checks structure and reports problems before processing.

KEY CAPABILITIES

Everything you need for this workflow

Excel exports

Download supported lists and reporting data for further review.

PDF output

Filtered datasets

Record coverage

Work with supported invoice, customer, item, expense, and report data.

Validation warnings

The planned import flow identifies formatting or required-field issues.

Review first

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions about import and export

Which exports are available?

The audited application includes Excel or PDF output in supported record and document areas.

Can every record type be imported today?

Broad CSV and Excel importing was not verified and is presented as planned.

Will validation fix source data automatically?

No. Validation should identify issues so the source file or mapping can be corrected.

Should exports be treated as backups?

Exports are useful copies, but they do not replace a complete tested backup strategy.
